title: Design System: The Google Gemini Build Record
creativeNorthStar: The supplied event deck opened into a durable public archive.
fontFamily: Google Sans Flex Variable, Google Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
rules: Stage-dark surfaces and thin rules carry the layout.
Blue is the principal signal; red, yellow, and green identify real tracks or awards.
Use flat editorial rows rather than rounded cards.
Keep finalists first and use stable shuffled numbering for all remaining builds.
Show project and demo link health independently.
